proposal.title: different-from(ref, by=key) / different-across(group, by=key) — what is a ‘different’ choice different from?

items.english: Distinct masons cut pairwise unequal colors; one may equal an outside reference.
items.ainglish: Each mason cut a stone, different-from(quarry-9, by=color).
items.question: May two masons cut stones with equal colors?

items.english: Every mason cut a stone whose color differs from quarry-9's; masons may repeat a selected stone.
items.ainglish: Each mason cut a stone, different-across(masons, by=color).
items.question: May two masons cut stones with equal colors?
